title: Create a Volur Account
subtitle: Enter your details to start your cyber security journey
username_tip: Your username will be your unique public identifier on Volur. 3-32 characters (letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens).
email_tip: A 6-digit verification code will be sent to this email to verify ownership.
password_hint: Use 6-32 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.
options_prompt: Choose whether to enable more secure sign-in options:
passkey_protect_desc: Passkeys are saved on your personal device for fast and secure sign-in to your Volur account.
passkey_create_desc: Passkeys are saved on your personal device for fast and secure sign-in to your Volur account.
passkey_guide_text: Click below to create your passkey. You can then sign in securely on this device without a password.
passkey_registered_desc: Your passkey is ready. You can sign in using your fingerprint, face, or device lock next time.
totp_protect_desc: Generate verification codes using apps like Google Authenticator for added security.
totp_protect_notice: After registration, you can manage your authenticator app anytime under Profile - Security Settings.
totp_scan_guide: Scan the QR code below using your authenticator app:
totp_step_verify_desc: Enter the 6-digit code generated by your authenticator app to complete setup.
totp_registered_desc: Authenticator linked successfully. Two-factor authentication (2FA) is now active on your account.
totp_load_failed: Failed to load authenticator setup, please try again
account_created_success: Account created successfully. Welcome to Volur!
password_setup_failed: Failed to set password, please try again
resend_failed: Failed to resend code, please try again later
